❗ Mistake 1 - Selecting the wrong payment method
Please note that our only top-up payment option is "Withdraw". There is no "remittance" or "payment". Our only official payment channel is "cash payment". So, again, you should never "send money" or "pay" money. Therefore, please select the correct payment method, otherwise CK44 will not be held responsible if you miss a payment due to selecting the wrong payment method.


❗Mistake 2 - Not filling in the transaction ID when withdrawing money
Depositing CK44 is basically done in two steps.
 The first step is to withdraw money to the company (bkash/nagad) account
The second step is to return to the transfer interface after the withdrawal is successful, fill in the form correctly (transaction ID/reference number/transaction ID) and send a recharge request.
Remember, if you do not fill in the transfer ID, you will not see the balance credited to your account after the withdrawal.


❗ Mistake 3 – Not entering the correct amount or submitting a deposit of the wrong amount
Please ensure that the withdrawal amount is consistent with the amount written on the deposit slip. We will not be responsible for any loss of funds due to incorrect information.


❗ Error 4 – Deposit less than 100 BDT
Our minimum deposit amount is 100 BDT. If you withdraw less than 100 BDT, you cannot send any deposit request for that withdrawal.


❗ Error 5 (very important) - Your correct reference number was not recognized
Transaction ID/Reference Number is the withdrawal identification number i.e. reference number for withdrawal or transaction ID are the same thing. Rocket's transaction I,D is 10 digits long, while Bikash and Cash's transaction I,D look like a combination of letters and numbers. Find and copy the transaction ID from the withdrawal slip and enter it exactly into the reference number box on the deposit form. Then fill in the transaction ID on the recharge page
Always use zero (0) and the letter O when writing reference numbers.
